headlines.summary: On Sunday, Nvidia announced it was launching an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, an AI executive and agent of the Chinese government. In addition to the Board of Directors announcing the investigation, Huang sent a memo to Nvidia employees acknowledging the affair.

concept.title: Tokens & Context Windows
concept.body: Models read and bill in 'tokens' (word fragments), and a 'context window' caps how much they consider at once. Bigger context lets you feed more, but cost and latency rise with it.
concept.takeaway: Watch cost-per-task, not just cost-per-token — verbose prompts add up fast.
